Best fit — and when to skip it

tsx is most relevant to developers working with JavaScript/TypeScript. Its source topics point to cli, runtime, node, cjs. It belongs on a shortlist when that stated purpose matches a concrete requirement.

Skip or postpone it when the documented runtime, license, dependency footprint, or maintenance model conflicts with your project. Popularity alone is not a reason to migrate.
